evidence.excerpt: Plain-woven CFF (J9-2019066-1 K); PEEK film thickness 70 μm; ethanol used as received.

ASTM D2344; ASTM D7264; ASTM D3039; all mechanical tests repeated at least five times.
SEM Nova NanoSEM 450, platinum-coated samples; C-SAM PVA SAM 300, 30 MHz, deionized water.
